segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: There's one other intriguing mention in your book, Jacques, and you don't say when. When you say National Academy, I presume you mean the National Academy of Sciences. But during a conversation in 2025 about consciousness and higher reality, the colleague you're talking to responds, quote: The Academy, the National Academy, was told it might be defunded if we breached some areas. This is one of them. Talking about consciousness and higher reality. Jacques, you say it was warned it would be defunded if it entered certain areas. Who made that warning? Do you know?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: If you remember, the same thing happened in Russia fairly recently: they were told to stay out of certain areas, even though they had been briefed at the level of high clearances. My understanding, and I had that confirmed by other members of the academy, is that they have had conversations at that level, that they have looked at data, that they have had testimony from people who were cleared for the data, and that they were simply told that it was not the place of the academy to opine on the situation, that they had other things the nation was trusting them to do, and that this was not one of them.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Can I clarify, though, Jacques: was the forbidden subject UFOs, or consciousness?

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: And so the National Academy of Sciences of the United States was warned that it would be defunded if it sought to investigate UFOs.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: That's what I was told by a member in good standing of the academy, yes — and they were not new to the subject. This is somebody I've known and worked with for many years, and we trusted each other on projects.
